visualCharacteristics: Centred section title above a filter bar of dropdown select buttons plus search; collapses to an 'Open filters' toggle panel below 1024px.
contentPattern: Row 1: heading title; then one row per filter: label paragraph | dropdown heading paragraph + options list (first item 'All'); final single-paragraph row = search field label.
usage: Use above a cards-wall listing to show a title and filter dropdowns with search.
reuseGuidance: Reuse on listing pages by adding one row per filter with its options list and a final search label row.
